mdLine: Fixed iOS header positioning on the Support, Bug Report, and Feature Request screens — headers were rendering under the status bar and notch on iOS because `StatusBar.currentHeight` is Android-only. Replaced it with `insets.top` from `react-native-safe-area-context` so the padding works correctly on all devices. — reported by a LeadLens user. Thank you!
summary: Fixed a bug where the header on three screens (Support, Bug Report, Feature Request) would appear behind the iOS status bar or notch due to use of the Android-only StatusBar.currentHeight value. The fix swaps in insets.top from react-native-safe-area-context, which works correctly on both platforms.
